title: Evidence Schedule for Damage Reports under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
The count of photographs and documents a damage report carries under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan starts from the evidence minimum the plan publishes, taken as published, and nothing further is asked of the report. The count is a whole number of documents and is never below one. Every figure the plan publishes, the evidence minimum among them, is read from the plan the enrolment is written on.

### The evidence minimum each plan publishes

| Plan the enrolment is written on | Evidence minimum |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 8 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 8 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 12 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 12 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 14 |

### Worked figure

For a vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, the plan publishes an evidence minimum of 10, so the report carries 10 photographs and documents. For a vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan the count is 14, and for one written on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan it is 8.

### The floor on the count

The count is never below one, so even the smallest figure the arithmetic could produce leaves a report carrying at least one photograph or document, and the count is always a whole number of items rather than a fraction of one.
